component.name: Android SDK Platform Tools
component.summary: Debug Android devices with adb and fastboot

description.p: Android SDK Platform Tools provides adb for communicating with Android devices and fastboot for bootloader operations. This unofficial community package downloads Google's official Linux ZIP at install time and runs its tools unmodified. The SDK terms and the included open-source notices apply. FlatPark follows stable releases from Google's SDK repository.

Run flatpak run com.google.AndroidPlatformTools devices -l in a terminal. Select another tool with flatpak run --command=fastboot com.google.AndroidPlatformTools devices. The menu entry opens an interactive terminal with the tools available on PATH. This package is not a host Android SDK installation and does not provide an emulator or host udev rules.

USB access and network access are granted for device communication. Enable USB debugging and authorize the computer on the phone. The host must already allow your user to access the USB device. The broad device permission also exposes other devices. Your home folder is accessible for APKs, transfers and images.

ADB keys are kept in ~/.android, shared with an adb installed on the host. Earlier versions of this package kept them in a private directory, so a phone may ask once to authorize the computer again. ADB normally uses port 5037 and can share an existing host server. To use a separate server, pass -P 15037 to every adb command, including start-server and kill-server. ADB servers started here stop when the sandbox is killed; their keys remain.

Wireless debugging uses flatpak run com.google.AndroidPlatformTools pair ADDRESS:PAIRING_PORT followed by flatpak run com.google.AndroidPlatformTools connect ADDRESS:DEBUG_PORT. Use explicit addresses if automatic discovery is unavailable. Fastboot flashing and bootloader unlocking can erase device data; follow the instructions for your device.

ul.li: Allow working with files in Documents: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-documents com.google.AndroidPlatformTools
Undo optional permissions: flatpak override --user --reset com.google.AndroidPlatformTools
